description: A powerful file management dashboard for the Umbraco backoffice (Umbraco 16, 17, 18). Browse, upload, download, edit with Monaco code editor, preview media, rename, delete, extract ZIP, and import files via URL. Includes a Media Cleanup tool that scans for unused, broken, duplicate, orphaned and large media, plus a Recycle Bin view — with one-click actions to recycle, restore, permanently delete or empty. Role-based access control and zero configuration.
releaseNotes: v4.1.0: Security & configurability. The editable-file, protected-name and dangerous-write (RCE) extension lists are now configurable via uTPro:Feature:FileManager — EditableExtensions/AdditionalEditableExtensions replace/extend the editable list, while AdditionalBlockedNames and AdditionalDangerousWriteExtensions are additive (built-in protections can never be removed). The protected-name block list is now enforced on view/download too and was expanded (appsettings.production.json, appsettings.staging.json, .env). A new RCE guard blocks creating/saving/renaming server-executable files (.cshtml/.razor/.aspx/.php/.exe...). The media-file and scan-media endpoints now require authorization; SVG files are served as attachments (never inline); import-from-URL re-validates every redirect hop against the DNS-based (IPv6-aware) SSRF guard. Performance: Media Cleanup removes the N+1 tracked-reference queries (batched) and skips hashing files with a unique size. No breaking API changes. v4.0.0: Media Cleanup is now its own workspace tab next to File Manager (no more "Scan Media" toggle). Opening the tab auto-scans and shows overview cards per category (Unused, Broken, Duplicates, Orphaned, Large, Disallowed, Recycle Bin) — click a card to drill in; a breadcrumb navigates back; row/bulk actions stay in the footer. Media-backed rows link straight to their node in the Media section (opens in a new tab). No breaking server API changes; hard-refresh the backoffice after upgrading (new workspace manifest). v3.1.1: New "Disallowed" Media Cleanup category — physical media files whose extension is in Umbraco's Content:DisallowedUploadedFileExtensions (potential security risk), with recycle/delete actions. Added an ignore list (uTPro:Feature:FileManager:IgnoredMediaIds) to silence false positives in Unused/Large, and scan guardrails (MediaScanMaxFiles, MediaScanTimeBudgetSeconds) that stop very large scans early with an on-screen notice. Upload validation now unions with Umbraco: BlockedUploadExtensions ∪ Content:DisallowedUploadedFileExtensions always reject, and when AllowedUploadExtensions is set it unions with Content:AllowedUploadedFileExtensions (empty = allow all, so site files still upload). No breaking API changes. v3.1.0: Media Cleanup is now actionable. Media-backed rows (Unused/Broken/Duplicates/Large) can be moved to the recycle bin; Orphaned files can be deleted from the media file system; a new Recycle Bin category lets you Restore, Delete permanently, or Empty recycle bin. The scan report is visible to any Settings user, while destructive actions require the current user to have Media section access (Admins always qualify). Also adds bulk actions (row selection), smart duplicate cleanup (keep 1 per hash group), inline media preview, and cached scans (MediaScanCacheSeconds, default 30s) so switching category tabs is fast; a forced reload or any action re-scans. Media lookups resolve by key via IIdKeyMap + GetById(int) for compatibility across Umbraco 16/17/18 (Umbraco 18 removed IMediaService.GetById(Guid)). No breaking API changes. v3.0.0: New Media Cleanup scan — from the File Manager footer, "Scan Media" reports Unused media, Broken media, Duplicates, Orphaned files and Large files (client-side paged, filter by category). The large-file threshold is configurable via uTPro:Feature:FileManager:MediaLargeFileThresholdMB (default 100 MB). Scanning uses Umbraco's media file system abstraction so it works with any storage provider. Report-only (no destructive actions). v2.1.0: Configurable upload limits via the uTPro:Feature:FileManager section (MaxUploadSizeMB, AllowedUploadExtensions allow-list, BlockedUploadExtensions block-list) enforced on both file upload and import-from-URL. Import-from-URL now uses IHttpClientFactory and includes an SSRF guard that rejects URLs resolving to loopback/private/link-local/reserved addresses and non-http(s) schemes. No breaking API changes. v2.0.1: Maintenance release — clean rebuild from a wiped output to guarantee the shipped assembly is current (packaging now goes through a deterministic clean-pack step). No source or API changes versus 2.0.0. v2.0.0: Support for Umbraco 16, 17 and 18 (multi-target net9.0/net10.0). Hardened path-traversal root check and upload filename sanitization. No breaking API changes.
title: uTPro File Manager & Media Cleanup for Umbraco (16, 17, 18)
